meta.methodology: Read framework.md, torah_18_packages.json, all reference===18 edges from torahData.js, and the full source text torah_18.txt. Scanned all bechina language in the source text (בְּחִינַת, בְּחִינוֹת, הַיְנוּ בְּחִינַת, נִקְרָא, זֶה בְּחִינַת) and compared against nodes present in the dataset with reference===18. Identified additions = concepts with explicit bechina language in source text that either (a) appear in dataset nodes not yet assigned to a Torah 18 package, or (b) do not appear in the dataset at all.

additions.reason: The Rebbe explicitly states: 'אֲבָנִים טוֹבוֹת זֶה בְּחִינוֹת עֲטָרָה הַנַּ"ל, בְּחִינוֹת רַחֲמָנוּת הַנַּ"ל.' The precious stones inside the basket IS the crown IS mercy. This is a direct bechina of the rachamim/atara cluster (Package 3). The stones are placed inside the basket (ארגז/רוגז = anger), which makes them the positive content within anger — precisely the image of rachamim dwelling within the transformed anger. Belongs in Package 3 alongside עטרה and רחמנות.

This is a direct bechina of the anger that manifests as hester panim. Belongs in Package 5 (Hester Panim / Anger) as the narrative container that symbolizes divine anger. additions.reason: The Rebbe states: 'חָלָּא – בְּחִינַת הִתְגַּבְּרוּת הַמִּינוּת, בְּחִינַת (תהלים עג): כִּי יִתְחַמֵּץ לְבָבִי.' The vinegar (chala) IS the strengthening of heresy/minut. This bechina places חלא squarely in the evil domain. It is the weapon used by bar amorai (the man of incomplete faith) to force down the biyarsha (faith's vessel) — so it belongs alongside the evil-polarity concepts. Package 5 is the most appropriate because חלא is the concrete instrument of the evil force that disables emunah and produces divine hiddenness.

additions.reason: The Rebbe states: 'כִּי בְּחִינַת בַּת-קוֹל, הַתַּכְלִית שֶׁל כָּל הַדְּבָרִים, הַיְנוּ שֶׁמְּהַפֵּךְ כָּל דָּבָר מֵרֹאשׁוֹ לְסוֹפוֹ, שֶׁהוּא הַתַּכְלִית.' The bat kol IS the tachlit of all things — that which flips speech from beginning to end, bringing the endpoint (purpose) close to the speaker. This is an explicit bechina connecting bat kol to the domain of tachlit/letters-completion (Package 1). The bat kol reveals the tachlit precisely because it reverses the word's direction, bringing the final letter (= the yud = World to Come) nearest — the very structure of Package 1's teaching.

additions.reason: Note: polarity is evil despite assignment to the emunah package, because bar amorai IS the person who lacks complete emunah — he is the negative pole within the emunah-domain. The Rebbe states: 'בַּר אָמוֹרַאי – זֶה שֶׁאֵין לוֹ אֱמוּנָה בִּשְׁלֵמוּת כַּנַּ"ל.' Bar amorai shares the essential NATURE of incomplete faith (the same domain as emunah, but its lack). This is a borderline case — it could form part of a new evil package (see torah_18_new_packages.json), but if assigned to an existing package, it mirrors the emunah cluster as its evil shadow. The node's essential nature is 'deficit of emunah' and belongs closest to Package 2.

additions.reason: The Rebbe states: 'אַטְמֵהּ – זֶה בְּחִינַת (ישעיהו לג): אֹטֵם אָזְנוֹ מִשְּׁמֹעַ דָּמִים – דְּלָא שָׁמַע בְּזִלּוּתָא דְּצוֹרְבָא מִדְּרַבָּנָן. הַיְנוּ בִּירְשָׁא הַנַּ"ל רָצָה לְהַפִּיל אוֹתוֹ לְשִׂנְאַת חֲכָמִים.' The atmah (deafening/cutting off the thigh) IS the quality of blocking one's ears to the sages' honor — which is what the biyarsha (emunah-vessel) tried to do to bar amorai. This belongs in the emunah cluster as the inverse-emunah action: it is the enemy's attempt to sever the person from the chachamim/mishpat dimension of malkhut. Note: polarity is evil as it describes the destructive act against emunah.

concepts_examined_and_excluded.reason: Line 17: 'תַּחַת הַנַּעֲצוּץ יַעֲלֶה בְרוֹשׁ – זֶה מָרְדֳּכַי; וְנִקְרָא יְהוּדִי, עַל שֵׁם שֶׁכָּפַר בַּעֲבוֹדַת אֱלִילִים.' This statement uses 'זֶה מָרְדֳּכַי' as an explanation of the Megillah midrash cited to explain בירשא = אמונה. The Rebbe is citing the rabbinic source to explain what the ברוש symbolizes. Mordechai's being called 'Yehudi' (= one who denies idolatry) supports the emunah identification of the berosh. However, the explicit bechina is between the berosh and emunah (via Mordechai's denial of idolatry), not a new node for Torah 18. The node 'מרדכי' exists in the dataset at edge 1519 (reference=17, bechina), where it is already classified as a concept in Torah 17. In Torah 18 it functions as supporting midrash for the ברושים-אמונה equation rather than a primary bechina node.

Lines 44-47: The Rebbe uses the ink-and-paper metaphor (שחרות=black ink, לובן=white paper) to illustrate the tachlit/tkhelet relationship. Lines 47 notes this explanation as the editor's personal interpretation ('נִרְאֶה לַעֲנִיּוּת דַּעְתִּי'). While the text does say 'סוֹף הַמַּעֲשֶׂה הוּא בְּחִינַת שַׁחֲרוּת' and 'תְּחִלַּת הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה הוּא בְּחִינַת לֹבֶן הָעֶלְיוֹן', this is an editor's gloss, not Rebbe Nachman's explicit bechina. Excluded per framework rule requiring Rebbe Nachman's language.

Line 23: 'רָאשֵׁי עָם, שֶׁהֵם הַמֹּחִין וְהַחָכְמָה' — the Rebbe says ראשי עם ARE the mochin/chochma (= the sages). This is a bechina-equivalent of חכמים (already in Package 4). It functions as a synonym for חכמים in this passage. Not an independent new node — it is the same concept under a different label, which is an alias situation. In addition, edge 1177 (משפט↔חכמים) already captures the sages domain.

Line 21: 'זֶה בְּחִינַת... וְהַמַּלְכוּת תֵּהָפֵךְ לְמִינוּת' and line 30: 'חָלָּא – בְּחִינַת הִתְגַּבְּרוּת הַמִּינוּת.' Minut appears as a concept but the text frames it as the DESTINATION or RESULT of corrupted malkhut (eitza), not as a bechina-equivalent of minut with something else. The only bechina statement about minut in Torah 18 is: חלא = התגברות המינות (line 30), which is captured in the חלא addition above. Minut itself, as a standalone concept, does not have an explicit bechina peer-node stated in Torah 18 (the verse 'כי יתחמץ לבבי' is given as a bechina of חלא, not of מינות). Not added as an independent node.

Lines 19-20: The Rebbe discusses that the core of rachamim requires removing all trace of idol worship ('עִקַּר הָרַחֲמִים בַּהֲסָרַת עַכּוּ"ם'). This is a causal/constitutive description of what true rachamim IS, but it does not use explicit bechina language to establish a new bechina node. The Rebbe says the manhigut's essence IS rachamim and rachamim requires removing accum — this is a definition of conditions, not a bechina equivalence. Excluded.
